# Scripture Pipelines — Repo Overview for AI Assistants

This repository contains Scripture Pipelines pipelines, prompts, and outputs.
It was initialized with the `sp init` command.

## Layout

- `pipelines/` – YAML pipeline definitions
- `prompts/` – prompt templates used by `llm` steps
- `outputs/` – generated artifacts written by `saveas`
- `docs/` – human- and AI-facing documentation
  - `docs/tutorial.md` – walkthrough of the starter pipeline
  - `docs/llmflow-language-quickref.md` – compact language reference

## How AI helpers should use this repo

- Prefer reading `pipelines/` and `prompts/` directly when editing
  flows.
- Use `docs/tutorial.md` to understand the starter example and how
  variables + `saveas` work.
- Use `docs/llmflow-language-quickref.md` for common YAML keys and
  step types; defer to the upstream engine docs for advanced features.
